name: Huzzler

sources.title: Submit your startup — Free vs Launch Boost comparison table and FAQ
Huzzler homepage — software reviews and founder directory

conditions: Free listing requires the Huzzler badge on your homepage — they check it every day while you are in the queue; removing it drops you from the queue
Free queue wait is stated as about 72 days, with manual review before going live
Free listings carry a noindex tag — Google will not show the product page
requirements: Any real product being built: SaaS, apps, developer tools, AI tools
Hand-reviewed — spam and 'empty promo pages' are rejected
Account creation required before submitting at /products/create
preparation: Product name, website URL, description and category
Huzzler badge embedded on your homepage before choosing the free plan
$39 budget if you want Launch Boost (instant publish, indexing, homepage Recently Boosted slot)
workflow: Create an account (Login/Sign up in nav)
Pick Free (badge + ~72 day queue) or Launch Boost ($39 one-time)
For Free: keep the badge live — it is checked daily until the listing goes live
watchFor: The ~72-day free queue is unusually long — plan around it or pay $39
Free product pages are noindexed, so the free tier's SEO value is limited to the dofollow link itself, not search visibility of the listing
Badge is verified daily — a deploy that drops it resets/voids your queue spot
Launch Boost is one-time, not a subscription
countsAsLive: The product's own page on huzzler.so is public and linked from its category; for Launch Boost it also appears in the 'Recently boosted' homepage section
unknowns: Exact badge markup/placement requirements (behind account wall)
Whether free-tier dofollow is permanent after the queue or badge-dependent forever
